text:
Predicates:
Striker(x) ::: x is a striker.
SoccerPlayer(x) ::: x is a soccer player.
Left(x, y) ::: x left y.
PlayFor(x, y) ::: x plays for y.
Premises:
Striker(robert) ::: Robert Lewandowski is a striker.
∀x (Striker(x) → SoccerPlayer(x)) ::: Strikers are soccer players.
Left(robert, bayernMunchen) ::: Robert Lewandowski left Bayern Munchen.
∀x ∀y (Left(x, y) → ¬PlayFor(x, y)) ::: If a player left a team they no longer play for that team.
Conclusion:
Star(robert) ::: Robert Lewandowski is a star.
